notes: Blend-state oracle (#3733). main.cpp seeds the main framebuffer with (128,128,128,128) and runs only FRAMEBUFFER_TO_SCREEN, so each shot is the seed RGBA verbatim while blending is off (the default). A blended blit mixes the seed into the purple default-target clear and reads (83,64,96,255) instead. macOS-only: each backend's references are captured on its own host.
